TSMC typically releases the prior month’s consolidated revenue around the **10th calendar day of the following month**, through its investor-relations “Monthly Sales” announcement and financial calendar. For example, September 2026 sales were reported on October 8, August sales on September 10, and October sales were scheduled for November 10. [[1]] 

The exact date can move earlier or later for weekends, holidays, weather disruptions, or other calendar adjustments: TSMC reported April 2026 sales on May 8 and noted that release of June 2026 sales was postponed because of a July 10 typhoon day-off. [[1]] 

For tracking purposes, treat the **8th–10th of each month** as the normal release window, but confirm the specific date on TSMC’s financial calendar because the company explicitly says dates may be adjusted during the year. [[1]]

sources.title: Financial Calendar - Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited
